text:
Yes, you're still in the window. Orders can be changed free within **2 hours** of ordering, from "My Orders". Since you ordered about 20 minutes ago, you have roughly 1 hour 40 minutes left.

- **Where to do it:** Open "My Orders" and look for the change option on your order.
- **Adding a pot:** The policy covers changing orders in general but doesn't spell out adding items. If you don't see an option to add one, I can escalate it to a Support Lead.
- **After 2 hours:** The order moves to the packing queue and can't be changed online. Support can try to intercept it before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed. So it's best to act within the window.
- **Your ZZ plant's pot:** It will arrive in a plastic nursery pot with drainage holes. Decorative pots are sold separately unless the listing says "potted".

If you're a Leafy Plus member, you also get 10% off pots and accessories.
